intro: Spellfire Robes is the culminating rite in the training of young Horde mages in the Undercity, completed by the tailor Josef Gregorian. After gathering rare components from across the realm, the apprentice is rewarded with custom enchanted vestments that signify their growing mastery over the arcane.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Here are your robes, friend. Wear them well.
